entries.text: Don’t you get it?! If you join Team Star, you can\nshine as bright as anybody![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_01

entries.text: Seriously, what’s with you? Don’t you wanna\nburn bright with awesome friends like us?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_01

entries.text: ...Not really.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0225_botan_02

entries.text: Look—we’ve got a quota we’re supposed to fill\nfor new members, so just sign up already![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_02

entries.text: Um... I’d rather not...[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0225_botanl_02

entries.text: Help her out
entries.label: common_0225_select_01

entries.text: Walk away
entries.label: common_0225_select_02

entries.text: Huh? You want in on this, too?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_02

entries.text: If you’re here to sign up, we’ll get to you next!\nWe’ve nearly got this one in the bag![VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_03

entries.text: We’re Team Star, kid. We burn so bright, it hurts\nto look at us! But you knew that, right?[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_03

entries.text:
So you know exactly who you’re messing with,
and you’re still coming at us with that attitude?\c
You’re scary, kid. If you joined Team Star, you’d
be looking down from the top in no time![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_04

entries.text: Ugh, another ignorant little nobody...\c\nHere I’m finally part of Team Star, and still I get\nno respect? I gotta work my way up the ranks...[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_05

entries.text: Hey—we can’t just let something like this slide!\c\nThe honor of our team’s on the line, so we’ve got\nno real choice but to battle, yeah?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_04

entries.text: That’s true! You keep watch on that little four-\neyes over there![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_06

entries.text: I’ll make sure this fresh-faced nobody ends up\nseeing stars![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_07

entries.text: Urk, why’s a nobody like you so good at battling,\nanyway? That’s just not right...[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_08

entries.text: No way, [VAR 0x1100(00FF,0100)]she beat you?![VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_05

entries.text: Does that mean I gotta battle this kid now since\nI’m higher up Team Star’s ranks?![VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_06

entries.text: Pero bueno! What do you think you’re doing?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_01

entries.text: Ugh! It’s that student council dweeb![VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_09

entries.text: She’s gonna report us if we don’t book it...[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_07

entries.text: I can’t believe you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_02

entries.text: You don’t have to go find randos to battle! You’ll\nhave all the battles you’ll ever need...with me![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_03

entries.text: That’s really not what happened...
entries.label: common_0225_select_03

entries.text: It was those Team Star punks...
entries.label: common_0225_select_04

entries.text: Wait—THEY picked a fight with YOU? Wow, I\nread that way wrong! Sorry![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_04

entries.text:
I get it now. You two have got Team Star written
all over you for sure!\c
I bet you were trying to pressure people into
signing up again, weren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_05

entries.text: Ah, hi. We weren’t...not doing that.[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_08

entries.text: Well, that explains it.\c\nAs head of the student council, stopping this\ntype of nonsense would normally be MY job...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_06

entries.text: But this is also the perfect chance for you to try\nmy amazing and ultra-rare gift to you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_07

entries.text: With this Tera Orb, you can [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Terastallize[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] your\nPokémon during battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_19

entries.text: Let’s see. After it Terastallizes, I’m pretty sure\nyour [VAR 0x0101(0001)] will beee...[VAR 0x1302(0002,0000)][VAR 0x0103(0002)] type![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_20

entries.text: Normally you’ve gotta take special classes to be\nable to get one of these Tera Orbs, but I put in\r\na good word for you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_08

entries.text: Now, time to give it a whirl! You’ll learn to use it\nfaster in battle than if I just explain it to you![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_09

entries.text: Wait, what? You want this kid to practice whaling\non us with h[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0202)]iser Tera Pokémon, is that it?[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_09

entries.text: Got a problem? You wanna battle me instead?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_10

entries.text: Hnnng... Never mind! I’ll take my chances with\nthe new kid![VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_10

entries.text: Then take your places, and...battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_11

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Nice, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You pulled
off
Terastallizing
no problem![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_22

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Nice, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! You didn’t
even
have
to
bother
Terastallizing
your Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_23

entries.text: Moves of your Pokémon’s Tera Type will hit even\nharder when it’s Terastallized, y’know![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_24

entries.text:
Sometimes you’ll find a Pokémon whose Tera
Type is totally different from its usual type. That
difference can open up your strategic options!\c
Gotta charge your Tera Orb at a Pokémon Center
after every use by healing up your team, though.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_25

entries.text: W-well... I’ll be on my merry way, then, yeah?\nHasta la vistaaarrr! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002E)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_b_11

entries.text: Me, too! Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(002D)]
entries.label: common_0225_sitappa_a_10

entries.text: So, yeah—Team Star is basically a group of\nstudents that like to kick up trouble.[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_14

entries.text:
They hardly ever show up to class, and when they
get together in groups, they’re a real headache.\c
Even the teachers don’t know what to do with
’em, from what I hear...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_15

entries.text: Um...’scuse me![VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0225_botan_03

entries.text: I...uh... I just... Well, thanks.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0225_botan_04

entries.text: So, yeah... See you around.[VAR 0x0114(002C)]
entries.label: common_0225_botan_05

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Awww, look at you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Already
becoming
a big
hero
around campus![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_16

entries.text: I don’t think I’ve seen that girl around. Maybe\nshe’s a new transfer, like you...\c\nThat Eevee bag, though! Love that fluff![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_17

entries.text:
Anyway, seems like the trouble’s died down, so
we’d better book it up to school!\c
Get ready to climb the worst staircase in
the world![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0225_rival_18
